Today's candle keeps pushing up: ETH and BTC already tagged a new high in the first half hour (ETH 1,712.25, BTC 61,230.0), right where the Asia session top lines up with the overnight high. The only zone in reach on each coin is a sweep-and-reject at that high, against the 24h move, but the method caps sweeps at B (never A+, never GO): with no A+ zone and every prior today measuring well under 40%, conviction stays low. Today is Thanksgiving in the US (reduced stock liquidity, no fresh USD data in the feed). Verdict: WAIT on ETH and BTC, watching for the rejection at the day's high or continuation into the first extension.
